keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row). Tuscany, the duchies of Modena and Parma and the Papal Legations; the gazetteer's Tuscany plus Emilia-Romagna comes to about 43,750 km2. The page gives no area; the region is my reading of 'Tuscany ... Modena, Parma and the Papal Legations' and takes the Papal Legations to be the Romagna provinces of Emilia-Romagna.

ledger.note: December 1859: the union of central Italy is formed. 'In December 1859, the Grand Duchy of Tuscany formed a union with the duchies of Modena, Parma and the Papal Legations, creating the confederation'; the infobox dates the 'Revolution' 8 December 1859 and an assembly elected from the four states met in Florence. Carlo Buoncompagni was Governor-General.

ledger.note: 22 March 1860: Piedmont-Sardinia annexes central Italy. 'on 11 March 1860, it was apparent that by an overwhelming majority' the plebiscite favoured union; infobox 'Annexation: 22 March 1860'; the Second Italian War page: 'on 22 March 1860, with French and British approval, the United Provinces of Central Italy' were annexed by Sardinia. The decree was presented to Parliament on 12 April 1860.

ledger.note: March 1860: the United Provinces end in annexation to the Kingdom of Sardinia, which becomes the Kingdom of Italy on 17 March 1861.

wars.name: Second Italian War of Independence
wars.outcome: The Franco-Sardinian victory over Austria in 1859 let the central Italian states expel their rulers; the United Provinces were annexed by Sardinia on 22 March 1860. Zones empty: the fighting ended with the armistice of 12 July 1859 (Second Italian War page), before the union of December 1859, and no ground of the United Provinces was fought over. [Reviewer eu-20-x, 2026-11-01]
wars.note: The war itself was fought in Lombardy; this state arose in its aftermath, so no zone is contested here.

certainty.note: The state is the union of four states whose frontiers were the old ones; the Legations' limit toward the Marche is the papal frontier, which no page opened describes.

sources.title: Second Italian War of Independence

notes: New dossier, a state Cliopatria lacks (the Tuscany dossier already lists it as successor). The region is Tuscany plus Emilia-Romagna as the gazetteer draws them; no page opened gives boundaries or area, so the fit to the four states' old frontiers is unchecked. The page names no Legations; Bologna, Ferrara, Ravenna and Forlì are my reading. Dates are the page's: December 1859 (infobox 8 December 1859 'Revolution'), plebiscite 11 March 1860, annexation 22 March 1860 (infobox) against 12 April 1860 for the decree's presentation. The page gives no establishment date, so the start month is the December union. Counterparts duchy-of-parma-and-piacenza and duchy-of-modena-and-reggio are Cliopatria rows owned by another group (eu-13); papal-states likewise.
